subject: Bhagavad Gita (Little Yogi)
three_second_hook: My 6-year-old wouldn't sit still for 2 minutes... until she started learning Gita.
verbatim_dialogue:
TEACHER: Who are we praying to? Take the name of that Goddess!
STUDENT: Saraswati!
TEACHER: Very good, and now what are we gonna say next?
STUDENT: Namastubhyam Varade!
TEACHER: Super, perfect! You remembered those two words, very good! Varade means asking for blessings.
geography_fit: US, UK, GCC, Canada, Australia & India Metros
